output_contract.times: list of floats, identical to the 'times' field above
output_contract.values: object mapping each required species name to a list of floats of the same length as 'times'

tolerance_definition: A trajectory matches when, for every required species, max_i |value_i - reference_i| / scale <= 1e-3, where scale is the maximum absolute reference value of that species over the window (see gold/<case_id>.gold.json -> answer.scales).
